crossRefs.note: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t…
I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders…
Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

translations.web: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
translations.bsb: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side— men much older than your father.
translations.kjv: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
translations.asv: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, Much elder than thy father.
